title: AIN'T NOTHIN' WRONG WITH THE RADIO
lyrics_synced:
[00:18.08] Sometimes she runs,
[00:19.81] sometimes she don't.
[00:21.54] More than once she's
[00:22.63] left me on the side of the road.
[00:25.02] The older she gets,
[00:26.75] the slower we go.
[00:28.25] But there ain't nothin'
[00:29.57] wrong with the radio.
[00:31.96] She needs a carborator,
[00:33.72] a set of plug wires.
[00:35.44] She's riden' me around
[00:36.94] on four bald tires.
[00:38.92] The wipers don't work
[00:40.24] and the horn don't blow.
[00:42.19] But there ain't nothin'
[00:43.48] wrong with the radio.
[00:48.05] I've got sixteen speakers
[00:50.03] crossing my back dash.
[00:51.97] Little bobbing dog
[00:53.47] watching every body pass.
[00:55.69] Dual antennas whippin' in the wind.
[00:58.71] Now, there ain't a country
[01:00.01] station that I can't tune in.
[01:03.90] She ain't a cadillac,
[01:05.87] and she ain't a Rolls
[01:07.39] But there ain't nothin
[01:08.69] wrong with the radio.

[01:29.61] late last night.

[01:34.17] He said I oughta run you in,
[01:36.09] but I'm letting you go.
[01:37.61] Because there ain't nothin'
[01:39.14] wrong with your radio.
[01:41.09] I got the best lookin girl,
[01:43.28] in my home town.
[01:44.97] I asked her last night
[01:46.53] when I took her out.
